설명: Theme:, Theme:

Talisman is an adventure 보드게임 set in a high 판타지 medieval world.  플레이어 have 14 characters to choose from all based on role playing archetypes, such as heroes, wizards, villains, thieves, monsters, etc.  The game makes 플레이어 feel they are traveling the world to find equipment, weapons, ancient relics, and companions that will help them on their quest to acquire the Crown of Command.  Along the way they visit various locales in the worlds, battle each other and fantastic creatures to make their way to the top.

Goal:

각 플레이어는 is trying to move from the outer world and ultimately to the inner world. 플레이어 wander the outer, middle, and inner worlds trying to acquire equipment, weapons, and companions.  They will also improve statistics with equipment, companions, and encounters and battles with 판타지 creatures and each other.  Once they complete a Talisman quest, 플레이어 will enter the inner world and face its challenges to finally reach the Portal of Power to claim the Crown of Command.  Then the other 플레이어 must race to stop this 플레이어 before he eventually kills them all with the Command spell.

Gameplay:

To begin, 플레이어 select a character 카드 from among the 14 provided.  Characters have basic statistics to start.  These are Life [hit 점수], Strength [physical prowess], and Craft [Magic and Intelligence].  Some characters are naturally more gifted in combat and others in magic, while others are mix of the two.  Additionally characters are often differentiated with unique abilities, starting equipment, and starting spells.  This all makes the 플레이어 actually feel different during play.  In addition items and companions 플레이어 acquire during play also add to statistics, increasing Strength, Craft, Life or adding new abilities, etc.

Actual game play is relatively simple, making the game easy to pick up with novices.  On a 플레이어's 턴 they throw a die for movement.  플레이어 then chooses which direction, left or right, or if meeting qualifications may be able to move from outer to middle world, or middle to inner world.  Once on space, 플레이어 follows instructions on space, or encounters face up 카드 already in space, or other 플레이어 if in space.  Most spaces have a 플레이어 draw a number of 카드 to encounter.  These can be creatures, companions, weapons, equipment, treasure, or relics.  플레이어 must fight creatures and win before acquiring any other items or companions.  If another 플레이어 is in the space, 플레이어 may attack with either Craft or Strength but are not required to do so.  The defender defends with same statistic attacked with.  If the defender loses, he loses a life and an item or companion of attackers choice.  If the attacker loses, he loses a life.

플레이어 start in the outer world, and build up their character's statistics and items to try and move to the middle world.  There are two ways to move up to the middle world, one requiring a test of strength and the other a boat man's ride for a price.  Once in the middle world, play proceeds in the same manner, but the challenge generally is increased with more threats such as the desert and temple.  However, there is more potential for encounters and items as most spaces now draw more than one 카드.

In the middle world, 플레이어 may also acquire a Talisman quest, that once completed, will grant them a Talisman.  The Talisman is required to unlock the Crown of Command and pass through the Portal of Power in the Inner World.

Once 플레이어 have a Talisman and have enough Strength or Craft to enter the Portal of Power, they will try to enter the Inner World.  There they must face and survive the guardians there, like the Vampire's Tower and Werewolf before claiming the Crown of Command.  Once a 플레이어 claims the Crown of Command, they can cast the Command Spell, automatically forcing a 플레이어 to lose a life.  It then becomes a race for the Crown as the other 플레이어 try to take the 플레이어 with the Crown down before he finishes them all off.
